div.div: Future implementation content This page is provided to show the expected direction of future implementation work. It is not part of the proposed material for evaluation in this publication; mappings, target artefacts and profiling details are expected to evolve in subsequent iterations of this guide.

Yellow row/cells: In this ballot publication, some row/cells of the mapping table have been left in yellow to indicate areas requiring further review or refinement; including feedback from the Xt-EHR joint action (see note above). These highlights will be addressed in subsequent updates to ensure accuracy and completeness of the mappings.

body.p: This page explains how elements from the ClinicalCancerProgression logical model are expressed in the FHIR Resource ObservationClinicalCancerProgressionEuCcm resource used by this Implementation Guide.

tr.td: Here only the CancerConditionCcm can be referenced. It is also important to note, that the code of the observation is always set to code = $loinc#97509-4 "Cancer disease progression".
Here the status of the disease at this time is being set. Here values out of a Snomed CT Value set is requiered to use.
Here the classification system used for the tumor grading can be entered.
Here the corresponding value of the classification system used to grade the tumor can be entered.
Here the date when the progression/status was asserted/recorded must be entered.
Here the extent of disease can be recorded. Here values out of a Snomed CT Value set is requiered to use.
This extension is only present, when the extent type is loco-regional.
This extension is only present, when the extent type is metastatic.
